items.q: one of my dear, dear friends, I suggested, and Eddie Condon hired him -- was Bigun -- Walter Page.

ctx.x: Our first bass player was Bob Casey, and he had become -- he used to have a drinking problem, and he was on

the wagon trying to make his life, and he couldn't stand being around all the drunks down there, so one of the -- I'll take a pat on the back -- one of my dear, dear friends, I suggested, and Eddie Condon hired him -- was Bigun -- Walter Page.
